name: Maisaka Mai
source:
A year your junior at your school.
As her mother is a busy hard worker, Mai handles the home front.
Unspectacularly adequate at class and sports, but a dervish with a broom and alchemist with a spoon.
"My heart always leaps when you pat me on the head."

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/sutadhisutedhi-en-zh/]Johren.games[/url]]

Hobby: Housekeeping
Favorite Food: Strawberry Cake
Relationship Goals: Please pat me on the head.

[spoiler] She makes an appearance in Study § Steady 2 in [url=https://vndb.org/c100707/]Yae[/url]'s route as Reido's lover.
She also makes a brief appearance in [url=https://vndb.org/c100706]Yuno[/url]'s route. [/spoiler]
